00245 inline JuceIOHostInternal::JuceIOHostInternal(JuceIOHost *owner, 
00246                         const int numInputs, 
00247                         const int numOutputs, 
00248                         const int preferredBufferSize, 
00249                         const bool useTimerDeleter) throw()
00250 : owner_(owner),
00251   numInputs_(numInputs < 0 ? 0 : numInputs),
00252   numOutputs_(numOutputs < 0 ? 0 : numOutputs),
00253   bufferSize(preferredBufferSize),
00254   juceDeleter(0)
00255 {
00256   ugen_assert(numInputs == numInputs_);
00257   ugen_assert(numOutputs == numOutputs_);
00258   ugen_assert(bufferSize == preferredBufferSize);
00259   
00260   const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00261   UGen::initialise();
00262   if(useTimerDeleter) 
00263   {
00264     juceDeleter = new JuceTimerDeleter();
00265     UGen::setDeleter(juceDeleter);
00266   }
00267   
00268 #ifndef UGEN_NOEXTGPL
00269   Ran088::defaultGenerator().setSeed(Time::currentTimeMillis());
00270 #endif
00271   startTimer(50);
00272   
00273   output_ = Plug::AR(UGen::emptyChannels(numOutputs_), false);
00274 }

00281 }

00283 inline void JuceIOHostInternal::timerCallback()
00284 {
00285   stopTimer();
00286   
00287   String error = audioDeviceManager.initialise (numInputs_, numOutputs_, 0, true);
00288   
00289   if (error.isNotEmpty())
00290   {
00291     AlertWindow::showMessageBox (AlertWindow::WarningIcon, 
00292                    T("JuceIOHostInternal"), 
00293                    T("AudioDeviceManager init failed \n\n") + error);
00294     
00295     return;
00296   }
00297   
00298   AudioDeviceManager::AudioDeviceSetup setup;
00299   audioDeviceManager.getAudioDeviceSetup(setup);
00300   
00301   if(bufferSize < 1)
00302   {
00303     bufferSize = setup.bufferSize;
00304   }
00305   else
00306   {
00307     setup.bufferSize = bufferSize;
00308     audioDeviceManager.setAudioDeviceSetup(setup, false);
00309   }
00310   
00311   if (error.isNotEmpty())
00312   {
00313     AlertWindow::showMessageBox (AlertWindow::WarningIcon, 
00314                    T("JuceIOHostInternal"), 
00315                    T("AudioDeviceManager setup failed \n\n") + error);
00316     
00317     return;
00318   }
00319   
00320   const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00321   
00322   if(numInputs_ > 0)
00323     input_ = AudioIn::AR(numInputs_);
00324   audioDeviceManager.addAudioCallback (this); 
00325 }

00327 inline void JuceIOHostInternal::audioDeviceIOCallback (const float** inputChannelData,
00328                              int numInputChannels, 
00329                              float** outputChannelData, 
00330                              int numOutputChannels, 
00331                              int numSamples)
00332 {
00333   // may need to be a bit cleverer with the channels in here..
00334   const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00335   
00336   int blockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(numSamples);
00337   
00338   owner_->preTick(numSamples, blockID);
00339   
00340   if(numInputs_ > 0)
00341     input_.setInputs(inputChannelData, numSamples, numInputChannels);
00342   
00343   if(numOutputs_ > 0)
00344   {
00345     output_.setOutputs(outputChannelData, numSamples, numOutputChannels);
00346     
00347     for(int i = 0; i < others.size(); i++)
00348     {
00349       others[i].prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID, -1);
00350     }
00351     
00352     output_.prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID, -1);
00353   }
00354   else
00355   {
00356     for(int i = 0; i < others.size(); i++)
00357     {
00358       others[i].prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID, -1);
00359     }
00360   }
00361   
00362   owner_->postTick(numSamples, blockID);
00363 }
